Plan Payment Data Elements Technical Notes: The files in this folder contain summary payment data for Part C Plans, Part D Plans, Part D Plan Reconciliation, and Retiree Drug Subsidy Plans. CMS releases summary Part C and Part D payment data after the reconciliation of Part C and Part D payments, as provided in 42 CFR §422.504(n)(1) and 42 CFR §423.505(o)(1). For additional information on the summary Part C and Part D payment data that CMS releases, see our April 15, 2011 final rule, "Medicare Program; Changes to the Medicare Advantage and the Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Programs for Contract Year 2012 and Other Changes," published in the Federal Register at 76 FR 21432. We have summarized the data categories for each file below. The categories of data are expressed at a summary level only. No proprietary information or beneficiary identifiable information is included within any identified category. In addition, in instances where the level of aggregation identified in a data category was determined to be potentially insufficient to provide adequate protection against any disaggregation, such data is not included in said category. Any risk-adjusted payment is standardized to a 1.0 risk score, meaning that the included numbers are equal to the average risk-adjusted amount divided by the average risk score. The applicable fields are noted below as "standardized to 1.0 risk score".
